Exceptional technology starts with exceptional people. Vannevar is a small agile team combining world-class engineers with veteran strategists who bring deep expertise in defense and tradecraft. We’re building a company defined by mission impact, user empathy, and disciplined growth. In just three years, we grew from $3M to $80M in ARR, achieved early profitability, and reached unicorn status—proving that disruption doesn’t require an ego, and staying power doesn’t mean standing still.

About the role

AI Agents are core to Vannevar’s products - powering user-facing experiences, data enrichment pipelines, and asynchronous alerting services. The Agents Platform team builds the platform and tooling to enable all teams across the company to build robust and reliable Agents that are trusted for high-impact Government use cases. You will be a technical leader driving the development and adoption of this platform and helping us innovate in the rapidly changing space of Agentic AI.

What you’ll do

  • Design and evangelize best practices for building AI Agents
  • Drive standards and tooling for Agent quality including evaluation frameworks, test suites, and benchmark creation
  • Partner with internal teams to find emerging product opportunities and build the tooling needed to support them
  • Collaborate with other platform teams like our data platform and identity access management team to solve governance problems unique to AI Agents
  • Stay current with emerging Agent techniques, tools, and best practices, particularly in areas like agent architectures, tool calling

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying backend, infrastructure, and/or machine learning systems in production environments
  • Recent experience and excitement for building with Agent frameworks like LangGraph, Claude SDK, Google ADK, or similar.
  • Advanced software engineering skills, including experience with distributed systems, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
  • A history of not only building great tooling, but evangelizing them within a medium-large organization
  • You have a passion for building reliable, performant AI systems and understand how they create value for end users
  • U.S. Person status is required as this position will require the ability to access U.S only data systems

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Remote friendly with WeWork access
  • Unlimited PTO, shared downtime during the federal holiday calendar, and company-wide off time at the end of each year

  • Lifestyle & wellbeing stipends

Sobre Coderio

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. Con una base técnica sólida y una mentalidad orientada al producto, nuestros equipos lideran proyectos de software complejos desde la arquitectura hasta la ejecución. Valoramos la autonomía, la comunicación clara y la excelencia técnica. Colaboramos estrechamente con equipos y socios internacionales, construyendo tecnología que genera impacto.

Más información:

Buscamos un/a Senior Mobile Developer con experiencia comprobable en Android nativo (Kotlin) y React Native para liderar la migración estratégica de nuestra aplicación nativa utilizada por operadores en planta hacia un ecosistema unificado en React Native.

Tu función principal será liderar de punta a punta el ciclo de vida de la migración (desde el relevamiento inicial hasta la puesta en producción) , asegurando capacidades offline-first críticas, integración resiliente con servicios AWS (IoT Core/Cognito) y los más altos estándares de rendimiento y seguridad en entornos industriales dinámicos y desafiantes. Trabajarás con alta autonomía técnica, reportando al Tech Lead y colaborando estrechamente con Arquitectos de solución, Ingenieros de Backend y QA.

Lo que puedes esperar de este rol (Responsabilidades)

  • Migración y Arquitectura:

    • Diseñar e implementar la migración Android Kotlin $\rightarrow$ React Native utilizando una estrategia brownfield/strangler fig para minimizar el impacto operativo en planta.

    • Definir y documentar decisiones de diseño arquitectónico como ADRs utilizando arquitecturas modulares (Clean Architecture / MVVM adaptado a RN).

    • Extender y respetar los contratos del monorepo (optimus-core) como fuente de verdad de tipos en TypeScript.

  • Integración IoT, Cloud y Datos:

    • Consumir APIs y streams de datos IoT (AWS IoT Core / MQTT) priorizando la resiliencia, la baja latencia y el consumo eficiente de batería en dispositivos industriales.

    • Implementar capacidades offline-first robustas (caché local, colas de sincronización y reintentos automáticos) para líneas de producción con conectividad variable.

    • Integrar esquemas de autenticación segura mediante AWS Cognito/OIDC y consumo de servicios cloud (API Gateway / Lambdas).

  • Calidad, Seguridad y DevOps:

    • Implementar estándares de seguridad móvil y cumplimiento normativo (almacenamiento seguro de tokens, hardening y OWASP MASVS).

    • Definir y configurar el pipeline automatizado de CI/CD mobile (build, test, firma y distribución vía Firebase App Distribution o GitHub Actions).

    • Implementar prácticas de shift-left testing (pruebas unitarias, de integración y E2E con Jest / RN Testing Library) y configurar observabilidad/crash reporting (Sentry/Crashlytics/CloudWatch).

  • Proceso y Mentoría:

    • Participar activamente en las ceremonias Scrum (Planning, Dailies, Refinements, Reviews, Retrospectivas) y realizar code reviews rigurosas.

Requisitos

  • +3 años de experiencia comprobable en desarrollo móvil nativo utilizando Android (Kotlin). (Se solicitará muestra de código o proyecto de referencia).

  • Experiencia práctica demostrable en procesos de migración o modernización de aplicaciones móviles en entornos brownfield (no únicamente proyectos greenfield).

  • Conocimiento sólido y avanzado en React Native: TypeScript, hooks, React Navigation y manejo de estado global (Redux Toolkit, Zustand o MobX).

  • Experiencia en implementación de estrategias de almacenamiento local (SQLite, Realm, AsyncStorage o MMKV) y lógica de sincronización offline-first.

  • Experiencia en integración con APIs REST, arquitecturas distribuidas y protocolos de autenticación (OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT / Cognito).

  • Familiaridad de trabajo con entornos cloud (Deseable AWS: API Gateway, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch).

  • Configuración de pipelines de CI/CD Mobile (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise o CircleCI) junto con esquemas de testing (Jest y React Native Testing Library).

  • Inglés técnico avanzado para lectura de documentación, especificaciones arquitectónicas y repositorios de código.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa dentro del sector de IoT Industrial, automatización o integración con sensores, sistemas SCADA o MES.

  • Comprensión de negocio orientada a la manufactura, métricas OEE y KPIs de planta (disponibilidad, rendimiento, calidad, paradas, scrap).

  • Experiencia práctica con protocolos MQTT y AWS IoT Core / AWS IoT Greengrass / edge computing.

  • Desarrollo de módulos nativos personalizados (bridges) y optimización de performance en dispositivos Android de gama industrial.

  • Experiencia trabajando en estructuras de Monorepos administrados con Turborepo, pnpm o NX.

  • Conocimiento de normativas de seguridad en entornos industriales (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).

Beneficios

  • Compromiso a largo plazo, con autonomía e impacto.

  • Rol estratégico y de alta visibilidad en una cultura de ingeniería moderna.

  • Equipo internacional colaborativo y liderazgo técnico sólido.

  • Plan de carrera, crecimiento y liderazgo dentro de Coderio.


¿Por qué unirte a Coderio?

En Coderio valoramos el talento sin importar la ubicación. Somos una empresa remote-first, apasionada por la tecnología, el trabajo colaborativo y la compensación justa. Ofrecemos un entorno inclusivo, desafiante y con oportunidades reales de crecimiento. Si te motiva construir soluciones con impacto, te estamos esperando. Postula ahora.

We are looking for team members that share our passion for applied analysis and who would be excited to be part of a mission-driven team.

The successful candidate will join Prosper’s Credit Risk team. The Credit Risk team uses analytics tools to develop strategies that govern automated decisions in Prosper’s online marketplace. A Senior Credit Risk Analyst at Prosper has the opportunity to utilize advanced analytical skills to develop verification and fraud strategies using models and data in order to manage credit decisions. An ideal candidate should have strong hands-on analytical skills and a passion for solving problems in innovative and effective ways. The faster and more agile risk strategies keep our marketplace competitive and ensure that we continue to deliver on our mission of advancing financial well-being.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Develop credit and fraud strategies to improve the credit performance by using data, machine learning models and advanced analytics tools to optimize risk decisions

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We're hiring a Detection Engineering & Response Lead to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll own the detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud - and lead a small, growing team of analysts and engineers.

This is a lead engineering role responsible for detection development, handling the most complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy.

What you’ll do

  • Lead detection development: achieve full MITRE coverage, maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats.

  • Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments

  • Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks.

  • Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure

  • Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents.

  • Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators.

  • Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc.

  • Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools.

  • Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response — with at least 1–2 years leading or mentoring a team.

  • Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure).

  • Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL.

  • Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal).

  • Working knowledge of threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Pyramid of Pain, Kill Chain) and how to operationalize them in detections.

  • Solid IR fundamentals: memory forensics, log analysis, network traffic analysis, and post-incident reporting.

  • Stakeholder management: able to coordinate across engineers, compliance, legal, executives during active incident phase. Serve as the primary owner and driver for complex changes, as a result of incidents post-mortem.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI/ML and GPU clusters related threats.

  • Familiarity with eBPF-based detection or runtime security tooling (Falco, Tetragon).

  • Background in threat hunting.

Why this role at Nebius

  • Build D&R at a company scaling from startup to global infrastructure provider in real time.

  • Ability to evolve our internal D&R platform into a new cloud security product, delivering novel security observability for a range of neocloud customers - from big tech to AI startups.

  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.

  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.

  • Flexible, remote-first culture.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Join Atomi: Reinvent how the world learns.

At Atomi, our mission is to help unlock the world's potential by optimising the way we teach and learn. Our platform combines cutting-edge technology with a creative, human-first approach, turning complex ideas into simple, engaging experiences for students, educators, and parents everywhere.

We’re driven by curiosity, humility and a relentless focus on quality and innovation. At Atomi, your ideas matter, your creativity counts and your work directly impacts how hundreds of thousands of learners engage with education around the globe.

Come build something remarkable with us.

The Opportunity

As a Content Creator, you’ll play an important role in developing educational content that helps teachers and students get more out of learning.

You’ll use your subject expertise to create clear, engaging and curriculum-aligned resources for VCE students. This may include video scripts, lesson content and assessments that turn complex curriculum requirements into student-friendly learning experiences.

We’re looking for someone with strong knowledge of one or more VCE subject areas, particularly Health and Human Development, Physical Education, Business Management or Maths.

Previous experience with the VCE curriculum is required. Experience creating educational content, teaching resources or assessments is highly regarded.

What You'll Do

  • Write engaging educational content - video scripts, assessments and text lessons.
  • Turn curriculum documents into clear, practical course and lesson plans that help teachers and support student success.
  • Break down complex syllabus points using your VCE subject expertise to write content that’s easy to understand and tailored to students.
  • Keep your knowledge sharp by staying up to date with subject content and evidence-based teaching strategies.
  • Follow a detailed style guide to make sure content is consistent and right for our audience.
  • Juggle multiple projects, manage your time well and meet tight deadlines.
  • Work closely with Visual Content Designers, Subject Team Leads and others to deliver content that’s accurate, engaging and on-brand.
  • Share ideas and help improve the way we work through feedback, workshops and team discussions.

What You'll Bring to Atomi

  • Deep knowledge of secondary school education (VCE experience required).
  • Strong grasp of how to deliver content that actually works for students.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills - you can make tricky ideas easy to understand.
  • A real passion for education and learning design.
  • Comfortable working with others and explaining your thinking clearly.
  • Confident using project management tools (or happy to learn).
  • Demonstrated success in the VCE curriculum, either as a teacher or student.
  • Teaching or tutoring experience is a bonus.
  • An interest in learning design is great, but we’ll provide training if you're new to it.

Working at Atomi

  • Tailored flexibility: Enjoy work-life balance with hours that adapt to your needs, whether for university, family or personal time.
  • Generous leave: Experience additional paid leave options as a permanent team member.
  • Location Independence: Work from Sydney, interstate or wherever you find inspiration.
  • Growth and development: Use ongoing opportunities to improve your skills and expand your knowledge.
  • Holistic wellbeing: Benefit from a comprehensive employee assistance program subscription and additional wellbeing leave, supporting your best self.
  • Parental support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for new parents, with additional leave specifically for birthing parents.
  • Work with the best: We know you want to work alongside the best, so we work hard to hire only the best.
  • Regular social in-person and remote events: Including team sports competitions, trivia nights and themed annual events.
  • Atomi access: Enjoy free Atomi services for you and your family.
  • Onsite teams: Our Sydney office is ideally located in a central setting with cafes, shops and public transport nearby.

How to apply

Ironically for an education company, we’re not huge sticklers for qualifications. We’re more interested in how your skills and experience can contribute to our team. Make sure to include links to any relevant projects, like your portfolio, writing, GitHub, etc. - whatever helps us understand what you're good at, what you're passionate about, and why you’d be a great fit at Atomi.
We also know great people come from all kinds of backgrounds, so even if you don't meet all the requirements we've listed, you should still apply.
Please note: You'll need Australian working rights for this role.

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talents with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms across industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech.

Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team. This means you work closely with internal teams, contribute to meaningful projects, and have real opportunities for career growth.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Product Manager to lead the development and evolution of our core product offerings. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of business, technology, and user experience, transforming high-level vision into actionable roadmaps that solve real-world problems. This is an opportunity to join a high-growth team where your decisions directly impact the company’s trajectory and the value delivered to our global customer base.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap based on market research and customer insights.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams to lead the full product lifecycle from discovery to launch.
  • Translate complex user needs into clear, detailed functional requirements and user stories.
  • Prioritize the product backlog by balancing technical debt, feature requests, and long-term strategic goals.
  • Analyze product performance metrics and user feedback to iterate on features and drive continuous improvement.
  • Act as the primary advocate for the customer, ensuring every feature provides a seamless and intuitive experience.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.
  • Proven track record of shipping successful products and managing entire product lifecycles.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to justify decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to bridge the gap between technical and nontechnical teams.
  • A "builder" mindset with a bias toward action and a passion for solving complex problems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and PM tools like Jira or Linear.
  • Technical background or experience working directly with APIs and data architecture.
  • Experience in UI/UX design principles and wireframing.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talents with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the company

Our client is a results-driven growth marketing partner specializing in the Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) and e-commerce sectors. With a proven track record of scaling over 150 brands and managing half a billion dollars in revenue, the team provides full-stack services across ads, email marketing, CRO, and customer retention. They distinguish themselves as proactive operators who leverage deep industry expertise and AI-driven infrastructure to deliver lean, profitable growth. By moving beyond "cookie-cutter" solutions, they build custom, data-backed strategies tailored to each brand’s unique customer lifecycle and inventory needs.

The company operates with a high-performance, collaborative culture that prioritizes transparent communication and accountability. As a fast-growing scale-up, they function as an integrated extension of their clients' teams, focusing on high-impact execution and measurable revenue boosts. Candidates joining this team will work in a fast-paced, innovative environment where data-driven insights and creative problem-solving are at the forefront of every campaign.

Job Summary

As the Head of Paid Acquisition, you will be the primary engine driving profitable growth across a diverse portfolio of brands. This is a high-impact leadership role focused on mastering Meta Paid Media to lower acquisition costs, increase scaling efficiency, and build the creative testing systems necessary for predictable revenue growth. You will bridge the gap between media buying and creative strategy, working directly with the CEO and Director of Operations to transform paid social into a powerhouse growth channel. If you are a performance-obsessed strategist who thrives on high ownership and the challenge of scaling high-spend accounts, this role is built for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the end-to-end Meta paid acquisition strategy, including campaign setup, optimization, and aggressive scaling.
  • Lead creative strategy by developing briefs, providing direct-response feedback to design teams, and analyzing the performance of hooks, angles, and messaging.
  • Monitor ad account performance daily, adjusting budgets and campaign structures to maintain peak efficiency.
  • Build and refine repeatable systems for creative testing, performance reporting, and conversion funnel optimization.
  • Develop high-converting landing pages, advertorials, and PDPs that align seamlessly with active ad campaigns.
  • Track and report on mission-critical metrics including CAC, CPA, ROAS, MER, and CVR, providing actionable insights to leadership.
  • Conduct competitor research and lead client strategy calls to ensure long-term brand growth and stability.
  • Collaborate with the video editing and design teams to increase testing velocity and identify "winning" creative assets.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience in performance marketing with a deep specialization in Meta Ads Manager.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing and scaling high-spend accounts within the e-commerce or DTC space.
  • Mastery of direct-response metrics (CAC, ROAS, MER, LTV) and attribution tools like Triple Whale, Northbeam, or Hyros.
  • Strong expertise in creative strategy and the ability to write compelling, high-converting ad copy.
  • AI-savvy mindset with the ability to leverage emerging tools for creative and operational efficiency.
  • Analytical decision-making skills with a bias for action and the ability to solve complex funnel bottlenecks.
  • Self-motivated and "hungry" personality, thriving in an environment where compensation is tied to performance and KPI hits.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to lead client audits and internal strategy sessions.
  • Availability during core business hours (up to 4 PM EST).

Nice-to-Haves

  • Meta Blueprint Certification.
  • Experience in an agency or multi-brand environment managing diverse portfolios.
  • Knowledge of CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) and advanced landing page strategy.
  • Previous experience mentoring or leading a team of media buyers.
  • Background in sourcing and managing UGC creators.

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals
